bio.text: Sally Ann Gonzales is a Democratic member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 20; she assumed office on January 9, 2023, and her current term ends on January 11, 2027.
She represented District 3 in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2011 to 2019.

She earned a master's degree in education from the University of Arizona in 1995, served on the Pascua Yaqui Tribal Council from 1992 to 1998, and has served as president of the Guadalupe Community Development Corporation.
Ballotpedia reports that she is not running for re-election to the Senate in 2026 and advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary for Arizona House District 20.
